title: microsteris micrantha
intro: Microsteris micrantha, commonly known as Chinese Angelica or Small-flowered Angelica, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Apiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Microsteris micrantha include analgesic, anti-arthritic, and anti-hemorrhagic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, joint inflammation, and heavy menstrual bleeding. The bioactive constituents of Microsteris micrantha include essential oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
